blocks.html: This was a state-funded project where I worked on a team to create a game targeted toward 3rd- and 4th-grade students, aiming to boost their motivation to pursue a cybersecurity career path. I primarily focused on programming and UI design, and helped integrate the entire team's contributions into the final game.
